title: Kenyan Lamb Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful lamb stew inspired by Kenyan cuisine, perfect for a cold evening.
instructions: 1. Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
2. Add the lamb shoulder and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
3. Remove the lamb from the pot and set aside.
4. Add the onion and garlic to the pot and cook until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
5. Add the tomato, stew, carrot, and potato to the pot.
6. Return the lamb to the pot and bring to a boil.
7. Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, until the lamb is tender, about 1 1/2 hours.
8. Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
9. Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs and accompanied by a cup of herbal tea.
